title: Why Your Prayers Fail (The Ancient Prayer Formula That Actually Works)
note: Started by vsc-new. Re-planned 13 Oct: the first plan (15 clips) cut where Kevin had no pause - 13 failed the edge checks, 2 could not be located. autoplan now plans on the pause map (pauses-<key>.json). Rules in CLAUDE.md and PLANNING.md.

clips.name: PRAY-FOR-THE-BLESSING
clips.open: You know, they have some desperate need.
clips.close: find the blessing and the treasure in it.

clips.name: NO-DEADLINES-FOR-GOD
clips.open: Another common mistake is people put deadlines
clips.close: you don't know what's off your radar screen
clips.short_ok: The whole mistake in one pass: the deadline, the examples (by Friday, this month, make so-and-so like me) and the reason it fails - you can't see what's off your radar screen. The next line runs on into the interviewer's question, so there is no later clean close.

clips.name: JOY-BEFORE-THE-WALLS
clips.open: They didn't pray for freedom. They were given
clips.close: before the walls came down. Not after.
clips.short_ok: A complete story with its own landing: they didn't beg to get out, they gave thanks, and the joy came before the walls fell. 'Not after.' is the twist.

clips.name: OUR-NOT-MY-FATHER
clips.open: If you're going to pray for something
clips.close: the source of everything in your life.

clips.name: HEAVEN-IS-NOT-A-PLACE
clips.open: Well, the word heaven is actually
clips.close: our provider who dwells within us as us.
clips.short_ok: One self-contained idea: 'heaven' is mistranslated and means 'who dwells within us as us', and Kevin restates the whole corrected line as the landing. The lines after it end mid-sentence, so there is no later clean close.

clips.name: FORGIVE-OR-IT-FAILS
clips.open: If you say to this mountain, be removed
clips.close: forgiven everybody in your life including your enemies
clips.short_ok: Runs right at about 40 s: the verse, the three-step formula and the forgiveness condition are all here, and it lands on 'including your enemies' before the next thought begins.
